market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move coincides with a real macro catalyst (weak data, credit event) or is thin/illiquid market noise; confirm 2y/10y yields are actually falling.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs fed funds futures (implied 2026 cuts) to confirm coherent dovish repricing rather than an idiosyncratic bid.
time_plan.2h: Re-check for reversal; assess whether equities are selling off (risk-off duration bid) vs rallying (soft-landing easing).
time_plan.6h: Reassess against any Fed speak, CPI/jobs releases, or headlines that could validate or refute the deep-easing scenario.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether the yield/duration move held; log realized TLT return vs expectation and whether the market signal preceded public news.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 10 Fed cuts (250bps of easing) in 2026 signals expectations of aggressive/emergency easing, typically driven by recession or financial-stress fears. That environment is bond-bullish: front-end and long-end yields fall as the market prices deep cuts, lifting long-duration Treasuries. The link from a dovish rate-path repricing to duration is mechanically strong, though the extreme-tail nature of a 10-cut strike means much of any signal is noise.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the DXY is softening and real yields (TIPS) are falling alongside the rate-cut repricing.
time_plan.1h: Check gold spot vs GLD and whether the move tracks the dovish rate signal or an unrelated commodity flow.
time_plan.2h: Watch for reversal if the probability spike fades as illiquid noise.
time_plan.6h: Reassess against dollar and Treasury moves; look for macro headlines justifying deep easing.
time_plan.12h: Log realized GLD return vs expectation; note whether signal led public data.

predictions.reasoning: Pricing in 10 cuts implies collapsing real rates and likely a weaker dollar, both classically supportive of gold. Emergency/aggressive easing expectations also carry a safe-haven/risk-off flavor that adds a bid. The channel is real but second-order and diluted by the tail-scenario framing, so magnitude and confidence are modest.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme easing path (10 x 25bps = 250bps of cuts in 2026)
Rate-cut repricing maps mechanically to Treasury duration (TLT) and, via real rates/dollar, to gold
12h window and 700bps tradability threshold far exceed plausible single-asset moves from this signal
Standard monetary-policy transmission: dovish path -> lower yields, weaker USD, higher gold
uncertainty_notes: 10 cuts is a deep-tail strike; probability moves are likely thin/illiquid and dominated by noise, not information
The 700bps tradability threshold is essentially unreachable in 12h for these liquid proxies, so this is not a tradable signal
Direction of equities is ambiguous: deep easing can be risk-off (recession) or risk-on (liquidity), so no equity index call given
Topic mislabeled as 'military_conflict'; this is purely a monetary-policy market

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks an extreme easing scenario (250bps of 2026 Fed cuts). A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive/emergency easing amid recession or stress, which is bond-bullish (TLT up) and gold-supportive (weaker dollar, lower real rates). Both mappings are directionally reasonable but modest in magnitude; given the tail nature of the strike, the signal is likely noisy and well below the 700bps tradability threshold, so confidence is low and neither prediction is tradable.
key_assumptions: A move in the market's implied probability reflects genuine dovish repricing rather than illiquid noise
Standard transmission holds: deep-cut pricing lowers yields and real rates and weakens the dollar
No offsetting inflation shock that would keep the Fed hawkish despite growth fears
failure_modes: The probability spike is illiquid noise on a deep-tail contract and reverses, with no asset follow-through
The macro information is already public (post-CPI/jobs/Fed) and fully priced into TLT and gold
Deep easing is being priced due to inflation/stagflation concerns, in which case gold rises but Treasuries could sell off, breaking the TLT thesis
Proxies are only partially exposed; idiosyncratic ETF flows dominate the modest expected move
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
